rules.description: Phase 1 supports non-EU students only.

then.message: This first version is designed for non-EU students arriving in France. Some steps may differ for EU, EEA, Swiss, or French students.

rules.description: A non-EU student with an unvalidated VLS-TS should prioritize validation after arrival.

then.next_action: Validate your VLS-TS on the official foreigner administration portal.

rules.description: If the student says the VLS-TS is validated, mark the step as done.

then.next_action: Keep the validation confirmation email or document for future administrative steps.

rules.description: If the student has not arrived yet, validation is a future post-arrival step.

then.next_action: Prepare the information you will need after arrival: visa details, arrival date, French address, email, and payment method or electronic stamp.

rules.description: CVEC attestation can block final university administrative registration.

then.next_action: Complete CVEC or obtain the CVEC attestation required for university administrative registration.

rules.description: If CVEC is done but the student lacks certificat de scolarité, university registration is in progress.

then.next_action: Complete administrative registration with your institution and obtain your certificat de scolarité or student card.

rules.description: If the student has certificat de scolarité or student card, mark university registration as done for Phase 1 purposes.

then.next_action: Keep your certificat de scolarité available for health insurance, banking, housing, and future administrative steps.

rules.description: Ameli registration is blocked if visa validation/residence documentation is not ready.

then.next_action: Validate your VLS-TS or prepare residence-status documentation before completing Ameli registration.

rules.description: Ameli registration is blocked if the student does not have university registration evidence.

then.next_action: Complete university administrative registration and obtain your certificat de scolarité or student card.

rules.description: If university registration and visa validation are done, Ameli registration is ready.

then.next_action: Register on the dedicated Ameli foreign-student portal.

rules.description: If the student is already registered with Ameli, mark the step as done.

then.next_action: Keep your provisional or final certificate available and follow next steps for your Vitale card if applicable.

rules.description: Bank account is ready if the student has proof of residence and enrollment evidence.

then.next_action: Prepare identification, proof of residence, and your certificat de scolarité or student card to open a bank account.

rules.description: Bank account may be partially blocked if residence or enrollment evidence is missing.

then.next_action: Prepare identification, proof of residence, and proof of enrollment or student card. If you lack accommodation, ask your institution whether you can use its international office address.

rules.description: If the student has bank account and RIB, mark bank/RIB as done.

then.next_action: Keep your RIB available for Ameli reimbursements, rent, CAF, and other payments.

rules.description: If the student has no permanent housing, housing setup remains a blocker for CAF.

then.next_action: Secure longer-term housing and keep your rental contract or housing certificate.

rules.description: If the student does not want CAF guidance, mark CAF as not relevant for now.

then.next_action: You can revisit CAF housing aid later if you want to check whether it is relevant.

rules.description: CAF preparation is blocked if the student wants CAF but lacks a RIB.

then.next_action: Get a RIB before preparing your CAF housing-aid application.

rules.description: CAF preparation is blocked if the student wants CAF but lacks a rental contract.

then.next_action: Wait until you have a rental contract or lease before preparing the CAF application.

rules.description: If the student has housing, rental contract, and RIB, CAF is ready for deeper Phase 2 readiness.

then.next_action: You appear ready for a deeper CAF readiness check. Phase 2 will cover detailed CAF documents and application preparation.

rules.description: If visa expiry date is known, create a future renewal reminder.

then.next_action: Track your renewal window: from 4 months before expiry to 2 months before expiry.

rules.description: If visa expiry date is unknown, ask user to check the expiry date.

then.next_action: Check the expiry date on your visa or residence document so the system can calculate your renewal reminder.
